setting.title: Upload the Google Sheets JSON configuration file here.
setting.help: Configure Google Sheets integration by uploading the JSON file.

p.strong: Enable API Access for a Project

ol.li: Head to Google Developers Console and create a new project (or select the one you already have).
In the box labeled “Search for APIs and Services”, search for “Google Drive API” and enable it.
In the box labeled “Search for APIs and Services”, search for “Google Sheets API” and enable it.
Enable API Access for a Project if you haven’t done it yet.
Go to “APIs and Services - Credentials” and choose “Create credentials - Service account key”.
Press “Manage service accounts” above Service Accounts.
Press on ⋮ near recently created service account and select “Manage keys” and then click on “ADD KEY - Create new key”.
Select JSON key type and press “Create”.

div.p: This is how your JSON file credentials should look like.
